name: Iowa
rate: 24% per year (2% per month) — highest fixed rate in the U.S.
rateNote: Highest fixed rate in the US — flat rate, no bidding
keyNotes: 24% is the highest fixed lien rate in the US
Affidavit of service deadline is strict — miss it and you lose the lien entirely
summary: Iowa holds its annual tax lien sale on the third Monday of June statewide. Rate is a flat 24%/year (2%/month) — highest fixed rate in the U.S. NOT bid down at auction. UNIQUE BID METHOD: Bidding is on percentage of property OWNERSHIP, not on rate or price. Lowest percentage interest wins. CRITICAL DEADLINES: After 21 months, holder MUST serve 90-day notice on owner + all parties of record (§447.9). After 90 days, file affidavit with Treasurer (§447.12). If affidavit NOT filed within 3 YEARS of sale, certificate automatically CANCELLED — total loss (§446.37). 99 counties. Statute: Iowa Code §446 (sales), §447 (redemption), §447.9 (90-day notice), §447.12 (affidavit), §446.37 (cancellation).
typeWhy: Iowa sells tax lien certificates at its annual June sale. The investor holds the lien while the owner has 21 months before the 90-day notice period begins. Iowa Code §446.
rateWhy: Iowa sets a statutory flat rate of 24% per annum (2% per month) on tax lien certificates — the highest fixed rate in the country. This rate is NOT auction-determined or bid-down; all certificates earn the same 24%. Iowa Code §446.
beginnerTip: Iowa's 24% rate is the best in the country. TWO critical rules: (1) Set a calendar reminder to serve your 90-day notice at exactly 21 months (§447.9). (2) File affidavit with Treasurer within 3 YEARS of sale or certificate auto-cancels (§446.37). Missing either deadline = total loss. That's the #1 mistake Iowa investors make.
risks: CRITICAL: Must serve 90-day notice at 21 months (§447.9) — missing this blocks deed
CRITICAL: Must file affidavit within 3 YEARS of sale or certificate auto-cancels — total loss (§446.37)
Bidding is on percentage of property ownership, not rate — unique mechanism
Agricultural land dominates inventory in many counties — limited development potential
Agricultural drainage district liens can be superior to your lien
ddExtra: Set TWO hard calendar reminders: month 21 (serve 90-day notice via certified mail) and year 3 (file affidavit deadline)
Bidding is on ownership %, not rate — lowest percentage interest wins
Subscribe to the county treasurer's mailing list for the June auction date
Check for agricultural drainage district liens — these can be superior to your lien

auctionSignup.platform: Iowa Tax Auction / GovEase (split by county)
steps: Go to iowataxauction.com or govease.com and find your target county's June sale
Create an account and register — ~$40 non-refundable registration fee + W-9 required
Third Monday of June statewide — register in advance
Full payment required at sale. Certified funds only.
auctionSignup.depositInfo: ~$40 non-refundable registration + W-9. Full payment at sale.

otc.note: Liens not sold at auction must be purchased directly from the county — contact treasurer after the June sale.

tylerCompliance.summary: Iowa reformed its tax sale surplus process through SF 569.
tylerCompliance.details: Iowa passed SF 569 (2024) amending Iowa Code §446.31 to require that any surplus from tax sale exceeding the delinquent amount, interest, and costs must be returned to the former property owner. The county treasurer must provide written notice within 30 days and hold funds for 2 years before escheat.

auction.bidMethod: Online bid-down — percentage of undivided interest (100% to 1%)
auction.certificateName: Certificate of Purchase at Tax Sale

adjournedSale.name: Adjourned Tax Sale
adjournedSale.note: Polk County holds monthly adjourned sales throughout year

otc.name: Public Bidder Sale / County-Held Certificate Assignment
otc.trigger: Parcel advertised AND unsold 2 consecutive years — county MUST buy
otc.availableWhen: After county acquires — contact county treasurer
otc.process: Contact county treasurer or board of supervisors for assignment
otc.note: Each county handles differently. Some forward to land bank / deed program.

subTax.name: Subsequent Tax Payment
subTax.deadline: Received by 4:30 PM last business day of month — postmarks NOT accepted
subTax.warning: If you fail to pay, taxes re-sell. New cert holder supersedes your right to pay subsequent taxes.

redemption.period: 21 months (1 year 9 months) before investor can initiate 90-day notice
redemption.whoMayRedeem: Titleholder, person taxed, possessor, mortgagee, vendor, lessor with recorded lease, any person with recorded interest
redemption.note: Payment must be received by end of month — postmark not sufficient

noticeOfExpiration.name: Notice of Expiration of Right of Redemption
noticeOfExpiration.process: Investor files notice → 90-day owner redemption window → deed if unredeemed
noticeOfExpiration.deedDeadline: Deed application within 90 days of expiration — or certificate CANCELLED
noticeOfExpiration.note: Cannot file before 21 months — county may bar investor from future sales

deedPath.name: Treasurer's Deed / Tax Sale Deed
deedPath.process: File Notice of Expiration → 90-day window → pay deed fee → deed issued
deedPath.absoluteDeadline: 3 years from sale date — certificate cancelled if deed not obtained
deedPath.note: Iowa deed clears most but not all claims. Quiet title recommended for marketable title.

surplus.name: No surplus process — redemption funds paid directly to certificate holder
surplus.note: Iowa deed process does not generate auction overbid surplus. Redemption = investor gets taxes+interest+fees directly from county treasurer.

es.summary: Iowa realiza su venta anual en junio. Tasa es un 24% fijo anual. Después de 2 años, debe enviar notificación de 90 días al propietario — no hacerlo en el mes 21 anula el certificado. Estatuto: Iowa Code §446.
es.typeWhy: Iowa es un estado de gravamen porque los condados venden certificados de gravamen fiscal en su venta anual de junio (Iowa Code §446).
es.rateWhy: La tasa fija del 24% anual es la más alta de todos los estados de gravamen del país. Esta tasa no se puja a la baja (Iowa Code §446).
es.beginnerTip: La tasa del 24% de Iowa es la mejor del país. La regla crítica: configure un recordatorio para enviar su notificación de 90 días exactamente en el mes 21. No cumplir este plazo anula su certificado permanentemente. Ese es el error #1.
risks: Debe enviar notificación de 90 días en el mes 21 — perderse esto anula el certificado permanentemente
La tierra agrícola domina el inventario en muchos condados
Las compras OTC requieren contacto directo con el condado después de la venta de junio
ddExtra: Configure un recordatorio fijo para el mes 21 — envíe notificación por correo certificado
Suscríbase a la lista de correo del tesorero del condado para la fecha de subasta de junio
Revise gravámenes del distrito de drenaje agrícola — pueden ser superiores a su gravamen

auctionSignup.platform: Tesorero del condado (varía — algunos en línea, algunos en persona)
steps: Encuentre al tesorero de su condado en iowa.gov/counties
Contacte al tesorero para confirmar la fecha de venta de junio y requisitos de registro
Regístrese con anticipación — participación en línea disponible en algunos condados
Financie mediante transferencia o cheque de caja según instrucciones del condado

otc.note: Los gravámenes no vendidos deben comprarse directamente del condado — contacte al tesorero después de la venta de junio.
